source_title: Ministry of Corporate Affairs — Companies Act, 2013 & LLP Act, 2008 Statutory Portals
issuing_authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Official government regulatory portal. Captcha-protected forms; automated harvesting prohibited. Professional CS DSC authentication required for filing.

source_title: Income Tax Department — Income-tax Act, 1961 & E-Filing System
issuing_authority: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Ministry of Finance
access_restrictions_notes: Taxpayer authentication and authorized ERI/GSP credentials required. Public AIS/TIS portal.

source_title: GST Network — Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 & Portal
issuing_authority: Goods and Services Tax Network (GSTN) / CBIC
access_restrictions_notes: GSP/ASP API connectivity requires licensed partner credentials. Public GSTIN verification portal.

source_title: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks (IP India)
issuing_authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
access_restrictions_notes: Public electronic search interface for classes 1-45. Zero automated scraping permitted; manual clearance verification mandatory.

source_title: Employees' Provident Fund Organisation — Unified Shram Suvidha Portal
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Establishment DSC / employer credentials required for ECR generation and monthly return filing.

source_title: Employees' State Insurance Corporation — Employer Portal
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Employer registration and monthly contribution portal.

source_title: RBI Master Directions — Priority Sector Lending (PSL) Targets and Classification
issuing_authority: Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
access_restrictions_notes: Mandatory banking directions mandating 40% priority sector lending allocation for commercial banks, with 7.5% specific sub-target for Micro Enterprises, and prescribing credit eligibility for Udyam-registered manufacturing, service, and retail/wholesale trading units.

source_title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 & Gazette Notifications
issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory enactment defining Data Fiduciary obligations, consent frameworks, and Data Protection Board mandates.

source_title: CERT-In Cybersecurity Directions under Section 70B of IT Act 2000
issuing_authority: Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In)
access_restrictions_notes: Mandatory 6-hour cybersecurity incident reporting window for covered corporate bodies.

source_title: Ministry of MSME Notification S.O. 2119(E) — Composite Criteria & Udyam Portal Framework
issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Official Gazette notification establishing Udyam registration, composite investment and turnover classification thresholds, export turnover exclusion, and PAN-based aggregation.

source_title: DPIIT — Startup India Gazette Notifications & Recognition Portal
issuing_authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory recognition framework under Section 56(2)(viib) of the Income-tax Act.

source_title: Bar Council of India — Advocates Act, 1961 Statutory Representation Framework
issuing_authority: Bar Council of India / Parliament of India
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory boundary governing legal representation in courts and tribunals. Confirms non-litigation corporate secretarial scope.

source_title: CraftEgon Corporate Services (CCS) Master Service Registry Decision Record CRAFTEGON-DOC-P2-002
issuing_authority: CraftEgon Corporate Services Executive Council & Technical Architecture Team
access_restrictions_notes: Authoritative internal decision register locking 57 routes, 54 active service IDs, and 3 referral-only boundaries.

issuing_authority: CraftEgon LLP Finance & Commercial Committee
access_restrictions_notes: Captured indicative website template figures from Phase 1 HTML service pages, preserved as unverified historical baseline data. Not an authoritative professional fee quote or binding commercial offer.

source_title: Companies Act, 2013 (Section 403) & Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014 (Table of Additional Fees)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Official legislative enactment and fee schedules published under Companies Act, 2013. Defines ₹100/day late fee calculation under Section 403.

source_title: Companies (Incorporation) Rules, 2014 (Rule 38 — SPICe+ Integrated Electronic Incorporation Web Form)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Government gazetted notification G.S.R. 128(E) integrating 10 statutory services into web form SPICe+ (Part A name reservation 20 days; Part B incorporation, PAN, TAN, EPFO, ESIC, PT, Bank Account).

source_title: Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Second Amendment Rules, 2023 (Rule 9B — Private Company Dematerialisation)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Official Gazette Notification G.S.R. 802(E) dated 27.10.2023 mandating issue and transfer of securities only in dematerialised form for non-small private companies.

source_title: Maharashtra Stamp Act, 1958 (Bombay Act LX of 1958, Schedule I Articles 10, 39 & 47 as amended by Act XX of 2015)
issuing_authority: Inspector General of Registration and Controller of Stamps (IGR Maharashtra) / Government of Maharashtra
access_restrictions_notes: Official state enactment governing stamp duty on MoA (Article 39: ₹200), AoA (Article 10: 0.2% on nominal share capital, max cap ₹50,00,000), and LLP agreements (Article 47: ₹500 to ₹5,000 tiered).

source_title: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (Schedule 1A Articles 10 & 39 as applicable to National Capital Territory of Delhi)
issuing_authority: Revenue Department, Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi
access_restrictions_notes: Delhi NCT statutory schedule prescribing stamp duties on e-MoA (Article 39: ₹200) and tiered duty on e-AoA (Article 10: ₹1,000 up to ₹1,00,000 capital, scaled upwards).

source_title: Karnataka Stamp Act, 1957 (Karnataka Act No. 34 of 1957, Schedule Articles 10 & 33 as amended by Karnataka Act 19 of 2014)
issuing_authority: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka
access_restrictions_notes: Karnataka state enactment prescribing stamp duties on e-MoA (Article 33: ₹1,000) and tiered duty on e-AoA (Article 10: ₹1,000 per ₹10,00,000 capital).

source_title: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975 (Maharashtra Act No. XVI of 1975, Section 5)
issuing_authority: Maharashtra Goods and Services Tax Department (MahaGST), Government of Maharashtra
access_restrictions_notes: Governing state statute for mandatory PTEC (business entities) and PTRC (employers) registration and periodic returns in Maharashtra.

source_title: Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1976 (Karnataka Act No. 35 of 1976, Section 5)
issuing_authority: Commercial Taxes Department, Government of Karnataka
access_restrictions_notes: Governing state statute for mandatory employer PT registration (Certificate of Registration) and entity enrolment (Certificate of Enrolment) in Karnataka within 30 days.

source_title: Constitution of India (Article 276) & GNCTD Trade and Taxes Position (Absence of Professional Tax Enactment in NCT of Delhi)
issuing_authority: Department of Trade and Taxes, Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi
access_restrictions_notes: Under Article 276, PT is a state legislative competence. Confirms that NCT of Delhi has no Professional Tax legislation; businesses in Delhi are exempt from PT registration.

source_title: Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (Maharashtra Amendment & Rules) & Directorate of Industries RoF Maharashtra Online Portal
issuing_authority: Registrar of Firms, Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
access_restrictions_notes: Official state e-Firms online filing portal for Form A firm registration and amendment submissions in Maharashtra.

source_title: Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (Karnataka Rules) & Department of Stamps and Registration
issuing_authority: Department of Stamps and Registration, Government of Karnataka
access_restrictions_notes: District Registrar of Societies and Firms jurisdiction for partnership deed verification and Form A registration in Karnataka.

source_title: Indian Partnership Act, 1932 (Act No. IX of 1932)
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / Ministry of Law and Justice
access_restrictions_notes: Central statute governing creation, mutual rights, registration of firms (Chapter VII), and legal consequences of non-registration under Section 69.

source_title: Societies Registration Act, 1860 (Act No. XXI of 1860)
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / State Registrars of Societies
access_restrictions_notes: Central statutory enactment governing formation and registration of literary, scientific, and charitable societies (minimum 7 members).

source_title: Indian Trusts Act, 1882 (Act No. II of 1882) & Registration Act, 1908 (Section 17)
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / State Registration Departments
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory framework for trust creation, duties of trustees, and mandatory registration of non-testamentary instruments under Section 17 of the Registration Act, 1908.

source_title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (Act No. 14 of 2013) & Rules
issuing_authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory mandate requiring every employer of an establishment with 10 or more employees to constitute an Internal Committee (Section 4) and file annual reports (Section 21).

source_title: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946 & Emerging Labour Codes Framework
issuing_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Central statutory enactment requiring employers in industrial establishments to formally define and certify conditions of employment and employee conduct rules.

source_title: Information Technology Act, 2000 (Act No. 21 of 2000, Section 43A & Section 79 Intermediary Guidelines Rules 2021)
issuing_authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory foundation for digital contracts, reasonable security practices (Section 43A), and terms of service / privacy architecture under Intermediary Guidelines Rules 2021.

source_title: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (Act No. 42 of 1999) & Current Account Rules, 2000
issuing_authority: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) / Ministry of Finance
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory framework for cross-border transactions, technology transfer payments, and branch office / liaison office regulatory approvals.

source_title: Secretarial Standards on Meetings of the Board of Directors (SS-1) and General Meetings (SS-2)
issuing_authority: Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI) / Section 118(10) Companies Act, 2013
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory secretarial standards specified by ICSI and approved by Central Government, compliance with which is mandatory under Section 118(10) of Companies Act, 2013.

source_title: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006 (Act No. 27 of 2006) — Chapter V Delayed Payments
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / Ministry of Law and Justice
access_restrictions_notes: Primary statutory enactment providing 15/45-day payment liabilities (Section 15), 3x RBI Bank Rate compound interest (Section 16), MSEFC arbitration (Section 18), 75% pre-deposit (Section 19), balance sheet disclosures (Section 22), and tax non-deductibility of interest (Section 23).

source_title: Ministry of MSME Office Memorandum No. 5/2(2)/2021-E/P & G/Policy — Retail and Wholesale Trade Inclusion under Udyam
issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Policy Division
access_restrictions_notes: Official circular allowing retail and wholesale traders (NIC Codes 45, 46, 47) to register on Udyam strictly for Priority Sector Lending (PSL) credit benefits, with subsequent clarification excluding traders from Chapter V delayed payment remedies and Section 43B(h) tax disallowances.

source_title: Income-tax Act, 1961 — Section 43B(h) (Finance Act, 2023 Amendment)
issuing_authority: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Ministry of Finance, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory amendment effective 1 April 2024 (AY 2024-25) disallowing business expense deductions for delayed payments to registered Micro and Small enterprises not cleared within Section 15 MSMED Act timelines. Explicitly excludes return-filing grace period.

source_title: Income-tax Act, 2025 — Section 37(2)(g) Actual-Payment MSME Timing Provisions
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / Ministry of Finance
access_restrictions_notes: Successor statutory provision under the Income-tax Act, 2025 (in force 1 April 2026) codifying actual-payment disallowance for overdue Micro and Small enterprise payables, continuing the 15-day / 45-day MSMED Act alignment.

source_title: Trade Marks Act, 1999 (Act No. 47 of 1999)
issuing_authority: Parliament of India / Ministry of Commerce and Industry
access_restrictions_notes: Primary Indian legislation governing registration, distinctiveness, absolute/relative grounds of refusal, infringement, and passing-off.

source_title: Trade Marks Rules, 2017 (Notification G.S.R. 199(E))
issuing_authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) / CGPDTM
access_restrictions_notes: Procedural subordinate legislation governing Form TM-A e-filing, 50% MSME/Startup fee concessions, Rule 33 examination 30-day response, and Rule 42 opposition.

source_title: WIPO Nice Classification (12th Edition) & CGPDTM Classification Manual
issuing_authority: World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) / Trade Marks Registry India
access_restrictions_notes: International classification system comprising 45 classes (Goods 1-34, Services 35-45) adopted under Rule 20 of Trade Marks Rules, 2017.

source_title: Supreme Court of India — Cadila Health Care Ltd. v. Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd. (2001) 5 SCC 73
issuing_authority: Supreme Court of India
access_restrictions_notes: Authoritative 7-factor test for deceptive similarity under Section 11 and passing off in Indian trademark jurisprudence.

source_title: Supreme Court of India — S. Syed Mohideen v. P. Sulochana Bai (2016) 2 SCC 683
issuing_authority: Supreme Court of India
access_restrictions_notes: Landmark ruling establishing that common law passing-off rights of prior users under Section 27(2) and Section 34 prevail over statutory trademark registration.

source_title: Supreme Court of India — Toyota Jidosha Kabushiki Kaisha v. Prius Auto Industries Ltd. (2018) 2 SCC 1
issuing_authority: Supreme Court of India
access_restrictions_notes: Adoption of the territoriality doctrine over universality principle; trans-border reputation requires proof of domestic spillover goodwill in India as on the relevant date.

source_title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 (Act No. 12 of 2017) — Sections 44, 16, 17, 47 & 50
issuing_authority: Ministry of Law and Justice / CBIC, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Principal enactment governing GST annual return furnish mandates, ITC conditions, apportionment, late fee structures, and interest liabilities.

source_title: Central Goods and Services Tax Rules, 2017 — Rule 80, Rule 36, Rule 37, Rule 37A, Rules 42 & 43
issuing_authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
access_restrictions_notes: Subordinate rules prescribing Form GSTR-9 annual return format, Form GSTR-9C reconciliation statement, 180-day supplier payment reversals, and capital goods apportionment.

source_title: CBIC Notification No. 15/2025-Central Tax (17 September 2025) — GSTR-9 Exemption up to ₹2 Crore Aggregate Turnover
issuing_authority: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
access_restrictions_notes: Statutory exemption under Section 44 proviso exempting registered persons with aggregate turnover up to ₹2 crore from filing Form GSTR-9 for FY 2024-25 onwards.

source_title: CBIC Notification No. 13/2025-Central Tax (17 September 2025) — CGST (Second Amendment) Rules, 2025 (GSTR-9 & 9C Reporting Modifications)
issuing_authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)
access_restrictions_notes: Amendments modifying GSTR-9 Table 6A1, Table 8 ITC matching, and GSTR-9C turnover reconciliation tables for FY 2024-25 reporting.

source_title: CBIC Circular No. 246/03/2025-GST (30 January 2025) — Clarification on GSTR-9 & GSTR-9C Interdependence & Late Fees
issuing_authority: GST Policy Wing, Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs
access_restrictions_notes: Authoritative circular establishing that where GSTR-9C is mandatory (>₹5 Cr turnover), furnishing GSTR-9 alone does not discharge the Section 44 obligation and late fees continue until both are furnished.

source_title: Supreme Court of India — Union of India v. Bharti Airtel Ltd. (2022) 4 SCC 328
issuing_authority: Supreme Court of India
access_restrictions_notes: Supreme Court ruling affirming that GST return filing and ITC availment is a self-assessment process based on the assessee's own books of accounts and documents, not solely on unilateral portal auto-population.

source_title: Supreme Court of India — Chief Commissioner of CGST v. Safari Retreats Pvt. Ltd. (2024) INSC 757
issuing_authority: Supreme Court of India
access_restrictions_notes: Landmark judgment determining ITC eligibility under Section 17(5)(d) on goods and services used in construction of commercial immovable property intended for leasing, applying the functionality test.
